Message:
“That girl is already
ten years old,
yet she still hasn’t
awakened as a witch.
At this rate...”

One stormy night,
I overheard my mother
say those words,
and felt my mind go blank.

At my whisper,
my mother and sisters
looked at me in shock.
Then, in pain...

Oh, I get it...
They all had those sad looks
because of how guilty
they felt about me, huh...?

I’m not a witch,
so I have no power...
That’s why I couldn’t
be given any training...

The reason I was never
allowed to leave this house...
was all so they could hide
their shame over me
not being a witch...!

I was the only one
born different...
I was the only one
confined here...
And I was the only one
they never...!

I then ran back to my room
and locked the door.

My head’s spinning so much...
I don’t know
what to believe anymore...!
